fix.service: packages/mpd-team-watchdog-plugin/src/holds.ts — HoldRegistry gains heldTeams(workspace), unread(reader, workspace), acknowledge(reader, upTo, workspace) and view(reader, workspace); every member is synchronous and non-throwing, and the acknowledge performs the write INSIDE the owning package. The absence is warned ONCE.
